source_scope: Official BMKG PPID and PTSP pages that classify public PM2.5 monitoring, service/request routes, and raw-data access limits.

evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Confirms the official access-route source family was fetched and hashed.
PPID catalog identifies public PM2.5 monitoring information and its update/access route.
Target BMKG station names visible on the public PM2.5 display page.
PTSP service/tariff context exists, but it is not a target-station certificate.
PPID reports mention certificate requests, not public target-station certificates.
The PPID consequence test classifies raw MKG observation data as excluded; this is access context, not certificate proof.
No public station-specific inspection log is exposed.
No target-station PM2.5 calibration certificate or calibration-status record is exposed.
No row reaches complete monitor-grade classification or station-radius readiness.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID public-information catalog row for air quality
source_records.matched_expected_terms: Informasi Kualitas Udara||Pemantauan Kualitas Udara||Kepala Pusat Layanan Informasi Iklim Terapan
source_records.source_note: Source-level PPID catalog route. Use it to test whether PM2.5 monitoring is public and hourly; it is not a station-specific calibration certificate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG public PM2.5 station display page
source_records.matched_target_station_names: Banjarbaru||Batam||Indrapuri||Kota Jambi||Muaro Jambi||Kemayoran||Kototabang||Medan||Maros||Pesawaran||Bengkulu||Pekanbaru||Talang Betutu Palembang||Musi 2 Palembang||Palangkaraya||Mempawah||Samarinda||Semarang||Kubu Raya||Sorong||Tanjung Harapan||Sleman
source_records.source_note: Station-display route for public PM2.5 readings and method language. It is display evidence, not inspection or certificate evidence.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PTSP service and tariff route
source_records.matched_expected_terms: Jenis Layanan dan Tarif||Jasa Kalibrasi||Betha Attenuator Monitoring
source_records.source_note: Source-level service and tariff route for PM2.5 information and BAM calibration. It is not a target-station certificate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID 2024 report with PM2.5 and certificate-request context
source_records.source_note: Source-level PPID report. Treat certificate language as request/service context unless it names a target-station certificate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID 2023 report with certificate-request context
source_records.source_note: Source-level PPID report. Treat certificate language as request/service context unless it names a target-station certificate.

source_records.matched_expected_terms: Informasi Yang Dikecualikan||SK PPID||Lembar Uji Konsekuensi
source_records.source_note: Index page for excluded-information documents. It does not itself close a station certificate/status gate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID consequence test for excluded information
source_records.source_note: Exclusion context for raw MKG observation data. This helps classify access limits but does not prove certificates are excluded.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID public-information list decree PDF
source_records.source_note: PDF copy of the public-information list. It is source-level catalog evidence, not a station-specific closure record.

non_claim: This scan classifies official BMKG PPID/PTSP access routes for PM2.5 monitoring and calibration/certificate context. It does not certify station-specific inspection logs, PM2.5 calibration certificates, calibration status, complete monitor-grade classification, same-station OpenAQ joins, or station-radius coverage.
